affinity.notes: Black fragments and intense violet cores strongly assert void or shadow affinity.

anatomy.notes: Head, shoulders, fists, and legs hold a clear humanoid structure through the fragmented treatment.

archetype.notes: Perceived role "bruiser-disruptor" does not semantically communicate Wrong-Fold Specialist (Specialist) or its battlefield duty.

counterplay.notes: Oversized fists telegraph melee pressure and the bright chest fissure reads as a vulnerable core.

finish.notes: Fragment edges, internal glow, and environmental debris are cohesively finished.

framing.notes: Full-body stance is centered with useful breathing room for orbiting fragments.

identity.notes: Blind perception "void-fractured colossus" semantically identifies void-horrors/void-horror-fracture.

tier.notes: Perceived tier "high" is outside the accepted set for intended T3.
